description: Send a plain-text email from the connected account. Optional 'attachments' is a list of blob ids (from blob storage) that are attached by filename + mime type. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the sent message id + thread id arrive via a follow-up message once delivery completes. Requires a connected account. This is a write action — it delivers real mail.
embedding_description: Compose and send an outgoing email through the connected Gmail account as a background job: a recipient address, a subject, a plain-text body, and optionally files pulled from platform blob storage to attach. Dispatch returns a job_id for tracking; completion delivers the sent message id once Gmail accepts delivery. The outbound mail verb.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the message send; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to send an email from the connected Gmail account.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing 'to', an unresolvable attachment blob id, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.permission_denied: the granted scope does not allow sending. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a 'to' address and valid attachment blob ids. gsuite.permission_denied: re-run connect_account so gmail.modify is granted. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
